description:
An own goal on purpose. Then defending BOTH goals.

Barbados vs Grenada, 1994: winning wasn't enough. The qualification rules made the seemingly irrational move useful.

Original illustrated reconstruction, not match footage. AI-generated narration.

#FootballHistory #CaribbeanCup #BarbadosGrenada
firstComment: Before full time, Grenada could qualify by scoring at either end. Barbados needed the match to stay tied to reach extra time.
